mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_TBL VALUES (#{userId}, #{hashPwd}, #{userName}, #{email}, #{userAddr}, #{phone}, 'C', 'O', SYSDATE, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT O.STORE_NAME, P.PRO_NAME, T.OPTION_NAME, S.VALUE_NAME, OPT.ADD_QUANTITY, OPT.PRICE_DIFF, D.PRICE, D.QUANTITY, D.LETTERING_WORD, D.SUBTOTAL, O.ADD_OPTION_PRICE, O.DELIVERY_FEE, O.DELIVERY_TYPE, O.FULL_ADDRESS, O.ORDER_DATE, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.ORDER_ID FROM ORDER_TBL O LEFT JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL D ON O.ORDER_ID = D.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL OPT ON OPT.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = D.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_TBL P ON D.PRO_NO = P.PRO_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T ON T.TOP_OPTION_ID = OPT.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL S ON S.SUB_OPTION_ID = OPT.SUB_OPTION_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY O.ORDER_DATE DESC
